relazioni.relazione_scritta: monotropic relationship (the phase transition A1 -> A2 is irreversible)
relazioni.note: La relazione monotropa e' dichiarata («are in monotropic relationship»); la maggiore stabilita' di A2 e' una congettura degli autori («we can speculate that RS-AI_S-Nap_A1, the less stable polymorphs, forms under kinetic control while RS-AI_S-Nap_A2 is the thermodynamically stable solid form»), sostenuta da punti di fusione (164 e 176°) e K.P.I. (67.7 contro 68.3 a 300 K). Nessuna temperatura di transizione.

relazioni.citazione: However, based on the melting temperature and enthalpy values, SR-AI_S-Nap_A appears by far the most stable anhydrous diastereomeric salt of the series (about 184°C and ΔH = 85.7 kJ/mol vs 164°C and ΔH = 37.9 kJ/mol for RS-AI_S-Nap_A1), with RS-AI_S-Nap_A2 in the middle (melting temperature 176oC, melting enthalpy ΔH = 51.9 kJ/mol).
relazioni.relazione_scritta: SR-AI_S-Nap_A appears by far the most stable anhydrous diastereomeric salt of the series
relazioni.condizioni: basata sulla temperatura e sull'entalpia di fusione (DSC), non su un confronto di solubilita' o sospensione
relazioni.note: Coppia di sali diastereoisomerici (SR-AI contro RS-AI con lo stesso naprossene): non sono polimorfi, quindi nessuna mono/enantiotropia. Il giudizio e' degli autori e si basa solo sulla fusione; il testo aggiunge che «SR-AI_S-Nap_A is the thermodynamically stable phase of the SR-AI/S-Nap salt» e che le energie coesive calcolate delle tre fasi anidre «are within the expected errors».

citazioni: Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) experiments were performed by using a Mettler Toledo DSC1 Excellence instrument. Measurements were run in aluminum pans with pinhole lids (samples’ mass ranged from 0.7 to 3.5 mg).
Measurements were carried out in the 40-200°C temperature range and a linear heating rate of 10°C/min was used. Experiments were performed in air.
Different was the behavior of the diastereomeric solid form RS-AI_S-Nap_A1. In fact, in the same temperature range, its DSC curve showed three thermal events (Figure S7):

a first endothermic peak (peak = 164.0°C, extrapolated peak = 164.1°C, onset = 163.9°C, ΔH = 37.9 kJ/mol) is immediately followed by an exothermic one (peak = 166.4°C, extrapolated peak = 166.7°C, onset = 166.4°C) and then by a second endothermic peak (peak = 175.9°C, extrapolated peak = 175.9°C, onset = 175.8°C).

These three events were tentatively attributed to the melting of RS-AI_S-Nap_A1 (first endothermic peak), the recrystallization of a second phase (exothermic peak), followed by its melting (second endothermic peak).
This observation is in keeping with the melting points of the two polymorphs (164 and 176° for RS-AI_S-Nap_A1 and RS-AI_S-Nap_A2, respectively)
eventi.note: Primo picco endotermico, attribuito (tentativamente, «tentatively attributed») alla fusione di A1. Peak 164.0, extrapolated peak 164.1 (nell'extra), onset 163.9 °C; DeltaH 37.9 kJ/mol. Intervallo DSC 40-200 °C (metodi) / «r.t.-200°C» (risultati). Nella discussione la fusione di A1 e' «164°C» e quella di A2 «176°».

eventi.note: Raffreddamento dopo la corsa DSC di A1 (fino a 200 °C, oltre la fusione a 175.9 °C): «On cooling no further thermal events were observed», cioe' nessuna cristallizzazione del fuso osservata in DSC. For example, on increasing the temperature, both the irreversible transformations RS-AI_S-Nap_A1 -> RS-AI_S-Nap_A2 (the two polymorphs are
in a monotropic relationship) and the dehydration of RS-AI_S-Nap_W to RS-AI_S-Nap_A2 occurred.
RS-AI_S-Nap_A1 forms only in certain conditions and underwent an irreversible phase transition to RS-AI_S-Nap_A2 after melting
eventi.note: Mancato ritorno A2 -> A1: gli autori dicono la transizione A1 -> A2 «irreversible» e le due fasi in relazione monotropa, ma non descrivono un esperimento di ritorno con condizioni sue (nessuna T, RH o trattamento). Evento per la sola irreversibilita' dichiarata, come prevedono le linee guida per il verso non avvenuto.

citazioni: Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) experiments were performed by using a Mettler Toledo DSC1 Excellence instrument. Measurements were run in aluminum pans with pinhole lids (samples’ mass ranged from 0.7 to 3.5 mg).
Measurements were carried out in the 40-200°C temperature range and a linear heating rate of 10°C/min was used. Experiments were performed in air.

The anhydrous SR-AI_S-Nap_A compound is stable from r.t to melting, as provided by the DSC curve (collected in the r.t.-200°C range) which revealed just one endothermic event, related to the melting of the compound (peak = 183.8°C, extrapolated peak = 183.7°C, onset = 183.5°C, ΔH = 85.7 kJ/mol, Figure S6).
eventi.note: Unico evento termico della DSC di F1: fusione. Peak 183.8, extrapolated peak 183.7 (nell'extra), onset 183.5 °C; DeltaH 85.7 kJ/mol. Nella discussione la fusione e' «about 184°C».

In Figure S8 the DSC curve of RS-AI_S-Nap_A2 is reported (peak = 175.1°C, extrapolated peak = 175.1°C, onset = 173.7°C, ΔH = 56.0 kJ/mol)

citazioni: Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) experiments were performed by using a Mettler Toledo DSC1 Excellence instrument. Measurements were run in aluminum pans with pinhole lids (samples’ mass ranged from 0.7 to 3.5 mg).
Measurements were carried out in the 40-200°C temperature range and a linear heating rate of 10°C/min was used. Experiments were performed in air.
As for the hydrated salt (RS-AI_S-Nap_W), its DSC curve showed two endothermic events:

the first one (peak = 129.6°C, extrapolated peak = 130.1°C, onset = 129.6°C, ΔH = 16.6 kJ/mol) which can be related to the loss of water; while the second, due to the melting of the resulting anhydrous compound, occurred at about 175°C (peak = 175.9°C, extrapolated peak = 175.9°C, 175.9°C, ΔH = 51.9 kJ/mol, Figure S9), i.e. the same melting temperature of RS-AI_S-Nap-A2.
To confirm that dehydration the hydrated phase RS-AI_S-Nap_W gave RS-AI_S-Nap_A2
eventi.note: Primo picco DSC di W: perdita d'acqua («can be related to the loss of water»), con peak 129.6, extrapolated peak 130.1 (nell'extra) e onset 129.6 °C; DeltaH 16.6 kJ/mol. Il prodotto e' «the resulting anhydrous compound»: l'articolo lo identifica come A2 con l'esperimento in stufa a 140 °C (evento successivo) e con la stessa fusione (175.9 °C), quindi a = F3 con certezza media. Nessuna TGA: perdita di massa non scritta. Crogiolo con coperchio forato. [Coordinatore: gruppo 'acqua' mantenuto come coordina_ospite, senza 'cambia' (il testo non dice che il legame si rompa; come l'esempio dello schema 'water is H-bonded to the amide N-H'). Dati strutturali anche nell'extra: voce X105.]

citazioni: The dehydration process of the RS-AI_S-Nap_W salt was investigated by keeping a microcrystalline sample of this salt in the oven for 20 minutes at 140°C. PXRD patterns were collected at the beginning and at the end of the experiment and compared.

To confirm that dehydration the hydrated phase RS-AI_S-Nap_W gave RS-AI_S-Nap_A2, a sample of RS-AI_S-Nap_W was put in an oven at 140°C (i.e. above its dehydration temperature as obtained by DSC analysis); the comparison of the PXRD patterns of RS-AI_S-Nap-A2 and that collected from the resulting solid form at the end of the experiment evidenced that actually they have the same crystalline phase (see Figure S5).
Finally, RS-AI_S-Nap_A2 was obtained only for dehydration of the hydrated phase RS-AI_S-Nap_W in oven at 140°C
in a monotropic relationship) and the dehydration of RS-AI_S-Nap_W to RS-AI_S-Nap_A2 occurred.
eventi.note: Disidratazione di W in stufa a 140 °C per 20 min (durata del trattamento), «above its dehydration temperature as obtained by DSC analysis»: il PXRD finale coincide con quello di A2. Atmosfera e RH non scritte. I gruppi: l'acqua e' legata ai naprossenati in W; il naprossenato di W ha la stessa forma di A e A1 («almost identical and definitely superimposable»), mentre in A2 il carbossilato e' eclissato (confronto fra strutture, non descrizione del percorso). citazioni: All single crystal samples (SCs) were obtained using ultrapure water (Milli-Q, Millipore type 1, 18.2 MΩcm resistivity at 25°C) and/or ethanol (96%) purchased from Sigma-Aldrich.
In all the tests reported below, 1 mmol of (S)-(+)-Naproxen (230.3 mg) and 1 mmol of cis-1-Amino-2-indanol [(1S,2R) or (1R,2S), 142.1 mg] were used.
(S)-(+)-Naproxen and (1S,2R)-(-)-cis-1-Amino-2-indanol were dissolved in EtOH (8 mL) at rt, and then H2O (2 mL) was added. After few minutes colorless needle-like crystals started to form;

Concerning the formation of the SR-AI/S-Nap salt, changes in the experimental conditions (temperature: 25 or 70°C; solvent composition: 4:1 or 2:1 EtOH:H2O; stirring at r.t. or at 70°C, for few minutes or 1 hour at reflux) did not influence the result and, in all cases, the SR-AI_S-Nap_A phase was obtained.
preparazioni.note: Cristalli singoli (SC), procedura 1: soluzione etanolica (8 mL) e poi aggiunta di H2O (2 mL), aghi incolori dopo pochi minuti. Metodo «antisolvente» e' la lettura di chi estrae (l'articolo non usa la parola): l'acqua e' aggiunta alla soluzione etanolica e il solido compare in pochi minuti. Rapporto EtOH:H2O 4:1.

citazioni: All single crystal samples (SCs) were obtained using ultrapure water (Milli-Q, Millipore type 1, 18.2 MΩcm resistivity at 25°C) and/or ethanol (96%) purchased from Sigma-Aldrich.
In all the tests reported below, 1 mmol of (S)-(+)-Naproxen (230.3 mg) and 1 mmol of cis-1-Amino-2-indanol [(1S,2R) or (1R,2S), 142.1 mg] were used.

(S)-(+)-Naproxen and (1S,2R)-(-)-cis-1-Amino-2-indanol were dissolved in 10 mL of a 80% mixture of EtOH/H2O, then the solution was left under stirring for 1h at reflux. After cooling colorless needle-like crystals formed;

Concerning the formation of the SR-AI/S-Nap salt, changes in the experimental conditions (temperature: 25 or 70°C; solvent composition: 4:1 or 2:1 EtOH:H2O; stirring at r.t. or at 70°C, for few minutes or 1 hour at reflux) did not influence the result and, in all cases, the SR-AI_S-Nap_A phase was obtained.
preparazioni.note: Cristalli singoli (SC), procedura 2: 80% EtOH/H2O (10 mL), agitazione 1 h a riflusso, aghi incolori dopo raffreddamento. Temperatura di riflusso non scritta.

citazioni: All single crystal samples (SCs) were obtained using ultrapure water (Milli-Q, Millipore type 1, 18.2 MΩcm resistivity at 25°C) and/or ethanol (96%) purchased from Sigma-Aldrich.
In all the tests reported below, 1 mmol of (S)-(+)-Naproxen (230.3 mg) and 1 mmol of cis-1-Amino-2-indanol [(1S,2R) or (1R,2S), 142.1 mg] were used.

(S)-(+)-Naproxen and (1S,2R)-(-)-cis-1-Amino-2-indanol were suspended in 9 mL of a 2:1 EtOH/H2O solution and heated at 70 °C under stirring until the total dissolution of the solid. On cooling the solution, the slowly formation of colorless needles was observed.

Concerning the formation of the SR-AI/S-Nap salt, changes in the experimental conditions (temperature: 25 or 70°C; solvent composition: 4:1 or 2:1 EtOH:H2O; stirring at r.t. or at 70°C, for few minutes or 1 hour at reflux) did not influence the result and, in all cases, the SR-AI_S-Nap_A phase was obtained.
preparazioni.note: Cristalli singoli (SC), procedura 3: sospensione in 9 mL di EtOH/H2O 2:1 scaldata a 70 °C fino a dissoluzione, aghi incolori in raffreddamento lento.

citazioni: All single crystal samples (SCs) were obtained using ultrapure water (Milli-Q, Millipore type 1, 18.2 MΩcm resistivity at 25°C) and/or ethanol (96%) purchased from Sigma-Aldrich.
In all the tests reported below, 1 mmol of (S)-(+)-Naproxen (230.3 mg) and 1 mmol of cis-1-Amino-2-indanol [(1S,2R) or (1R,2S), 142.1 mg] were used.
S-(+)-Naproxen and (1R,2S)-(+)-cis-1-Amino-2-indanol were dissolved in EtOH (8 mL) at rt, and then H2O (2 mL) was added. After few minutes colorless needle-like crystals started to form.

On the contrary, in the case of the RS-AI/S-Nap salt, the change of solvent composition led to the formation of two different phases, i.e. the presence and the amount of the water during the crystallization process plays a critical role in the formation of the hydrated (RS-AI_S-Nap_W) or the anhydrous (RS-AI_S-Nap_A1) salt (see Experimental Section).
Changes in temperature (r.t. or 70°C) or in the general conditions of the experiment (stirring at r.t., or at 70°C, for few minutes of for 1 hour at reflux) did not influence the result.

On the contrary, in the case of the RS-AI/S-Nap salt, the change of solvent composition led to the formation of two different phases, i.e. the presence and the amount of the water during the crystallization process plays a critical role in the formation of the hydrated (RS-AI_S-Nap_W) or the anhydrous (RS-AI_S-Nap_A1) salt (see Experimental Section).
